notes.title: Announcing Ver.1.4.0
notes.content:
Ver.1.4.0 releases Dec. 20th, 2023.

[h1]Ver.1.4.0 Patch Notes[/h1]
Please check the list of changes below for details on the main improvements and fixes in this patch.

[h3]- Added an audio settings feature[/h3]
Settings for the game volume and main menu volume can be changed prior to play.
Only the game volume can be changed during play.

Settings Screen - Before Play
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/79ebb6120b469c699c4db662393f42c40743b8f8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/6e95b40cb9122ddf79f2106745b86d04c9ec5fa4.png[/img]
Settings Screen - During Play
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/453504b32fcd4acba1ff99ce17ca05daac33a6f7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/802552310f68bca60cc46d36fde3250a38755321.png[/img]

[h3]- Added a "Window Mode"[/h3]
Added the ability to change the game to a "Window Mode" prior to play.
This feature can be turned ON or OFF by pressing Alt + Enter on the keyboard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/e05ed3ff7b9e46652a149520c0335134739fa8ad.png[/img]
[h3]
- Applied fix to have the game give priority to user set button designs

- Fixed some other minor issues
[/h3]


[h1]Issues Under Investigation[/h1]
We are investigating the issues below and working to resolve them.
We will provide further details regarding fixes for these issues at a later time.

- An issue where inputs via the keyboard are registered for the game even when the Alt key is held down


We will continue to provide regular updates on future improvements and fixes 
as further details are finalized.

notes.title: Ver. 1.2.1 Beta Update Notice
notes.content:
We have released a beta update that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2131680/view/3704833147710721125]resolves the abnormal speed issue[/url]. However, as this is a beta update there is a possibility that it may cause other issues to occur, and as such, we ask for your understanding. If this happens, please opt out of the beta and revert to the original release version.
Follow the steps below to opt into the beta.
[olist]
[*] Go to your Library from within the Steam Client and select “METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake”
[*] Right click and select “Properties”
[*]  Select “Betas” and input "[b]ecexea7MGp69[/b]" into the bar under "Private Betas" section.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/11a0ad4fa3a1ffe2e47477d63da3287eff642c5e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/a1e7523446bca8568b610066862346348d90e648.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/6e2c1837fc609372f640a3a2c2524f320fb55329.png[/img]
If successful, "Opt into: beta - beta test" will be displayed in blue underneath the bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/251eb781d8aef7f624eb239a866db92ab4ed3e78.png[/img]
The option to select "beta" from the dropdown menu in "Beta Participation" will then become available.
Once selected, the beta update will download.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/8e69ea6ac8620ec357d760111c77b47520652124.png[/img]
You will be able to play the beta version once the download is complete.
To revert to the original release version, simply change “beta” back to “None” in the dropdown menu. Once the download reverting the beta update is complete, you will be able to play the original release version.
[*] For those who are tried and are using the temporary solution, make sure to reset the settings to the original settings first before launching the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: Workaround for when the game is running at high speeds
notes.content:
We are aware that users are reporting issues with the Steam® version of METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1 resulting in the game running at abnormal speeds.
We ask for your patience while we conduct a thorough investigation.

We recommend that you try the following workaround as a temporary solution.
[b]This workaround is not necessary if you are not experiencing these issues. [/b]

[h2]Instructions[/h2]
[h3]For those using a graphics card made by NVIDIA® [/h3]
We recommend that you follow these steps below.
The screen configuration, etc. may be different depending on the which version you have installed.
[olist]
[*] Open the “NVIDIA Control Panel”, then select the “Manage 3D settings” located on the left-side of the window.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/0f2a33be82c4e1d45fbe5271612f63873943260d.png[/img]
[*] Select the “Program Settings” tab.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/90745920558916540ac73ef95d13faa047bd8c5e.png[/img]
[*] In the “1. Select a program to customize:” section click on the “Add” button, then go to the folder where you have “METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake” installed and select “METAL GEAR.exe”.
Once selected, make sure that the file location is displayed on the right-side of the “Add” button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/fe64bb1d4c77abe5d81893101db86b2812d79f0e.png[/img]
*The screenshots in this instuctions were all captured using the METAL GEAR SOLID - Master Collection Version.
The game title and icon that should display as you follow these instructions is "METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake".
We will replace them with the correct screenshots at a later date.
[*] In the “2. Specify the settings for this program:” section, make sure that the “Vertical sync” is turned on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/b037b3e0d59b26b51d16d4edc8b7b341163fecc5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/ef911c528bb1822467d76f8216d9d08adfad9257.png[/img]
[*] In the “2. Specify the settings for this program:” section, make sure that the “Max Frame Rate” is at 60FPS.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/5d10569a733e0643a766be78918cb6908a1d12c8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/c455230d74acf5b2b54ceb0cf1a771330208fa5a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/a857fddd36072084042f05d20548515cebae8a7b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/67692ff279d32a75ba98f109cf14865ba5232e46.png[/img]
[*] Click the “Apply” button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/87c733cac11764b73bfd7d000f0416c543fd18d1.png[/img]
[*] In the “1. Select a program to customize:” section click on the “Add” button, then go to the folder where you have “METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake” installed and select “launcher.exe.exe”.
[*] Follow the same instructions from Step 4.
[/olist]

[h3] For those using a graphics card made by AMD [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Launch the “AMD Software” that you have installed.
[*] In the “Gaming” tab, select “METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303409/8f5f0122236db7f7bd2104986fe47cb83c36017d.png[/img]
[*] Make sure that the “Radeon™ Chill” is turned on, with the Min FPS and Max FPS set to 60.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/4df3617b9ed49de287ed4144a2dea04c237df077.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/5a358e9b8fdf199fc31c9917d8df6a2234c2a39d.png[/img]
*The screenshots in this instuctions were all captured using the METAL GEAR SOLID - Master Collection Version.
The game title and icon that should display as you follow these instructions is "METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake".
We will replace them with the correct screenshots at a later date.
[*] Make sure that the “Wait for Vertical Refresh” is set to Always on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/b89432f0270e964444ead2c330767ca95101aa5a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277708/cd4160ce174a410025c00763f55a8c28551fb777.png[/img]
[/olist]
